회사 소개
쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다. 쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다. 보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.
직무소개
서울에 본사를 둔 쿠팡페이 제품 엔지니어링 팀은 제품 개발, 출시 및 관리를 진행하고 있으며 매일 고객을 열광시키고 있습니다. 혁신적인 고객 경험을 제공하는 소프트웨어를 만들고 확장시킨 경험이 풍부한 숙련된 소프트웨어 설계자를 찾고 있습니다.
업무
내용
Coupang Pay 및 Rocket Pay iOS 애플리케이션의 아키텍처 설계 및 개발을 주도합니다.
시니어 및 주니어 엔지니어들과 함께 시스템 디자인 및 기술 의사결정을 리드합니다.
Mission Critical 프로젝트에서 기술 리더 역할을 수행하며 복잡한 비즈니스 문제를 해결합니다.
엔지니어링 우수성을 높이기 위해 개발자들을 멘토링하고 성장시킵니다.

Product Manager, Designer, Backend Engineer 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하여 최고의 사용자 경험을 제공합니다.
iOS 플랫폼의 기술 방향성 및 Best Practice를 정의하고 조직 전반에 확산합니다.

요건

recruitingops@coupangpay.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture-shaping video games in entertainment, including

. We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.
Our portfolio is brought to life by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Visual Concepts, Firaxis Games, Hangar 13, Cat Daddy Games, 31st Union, Cloud Chamber, Gearbox, HB Studios, and 2K SportsLab create world-class experiences across platforms.
But what truly powers 2K is our people.
We believe the best ideas come from teams that feel empowered, supported, and inspired. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive workplace where people are encouraged to
come as they are
and do their best work.
What We Need
We are seeking a Senior Technical Product Manager to build and ship the technology that 2K requires to safely, scalably, and efficiently leverage AI across the business.
You will own the product pipeline for shared services and infrastructure for AI: identifying where 2K Technology should invest, defining what gets built, and driving it to a supported production service that studios and publishing teams depend on. This role suits a product manager who is highly focused on production outcomes and driving tangible business value. The work is judged on adoption, reliability, and cost. Success is enabling all 2K teams to maximize their leverage of 2K’s backend AI solutions.
Duties
Pipeline Ideas to Production: Turn concepts, prototypes, and business needs into shared-service products and infrastructure. Drive intake, prioritization, and acceptance, defining opportunity, customer, success metrics, and path to production before engineering commits.
Find the Right Opportunities: Work with 2K teams to identify where a central build beats a local build or a licensed tool. Lead build, buy, and wrap calls with engineering, backed by evidence on cost, adoption, switching risk, and time to value.
Partner and Communicate: Work with leaders across 2K to ensure AI investments extend existing capabilities. Publish a roadmap that customers and stakeholders can plan against, and report progress, cost, and risk to senior leadership.
Measure Success: Track what tells you a product works: adoption, task success rate, inference cost per unit of work, latency, and quality regression.
Build Governance In: Develop 2K's AI governance framework with Take-Two, Security, 2K Data, and 2K Trust & Safety. Instrument products so model usage, data provenance, and output handling are auditable by default, and teams building on central infrastructure inherit compliance rather than negotiate it.
Engage Technically: Hold your own with engineers and data scientists on cost and latency tradeoffs, retrieval versus fine-tuning versus prompting, evaluation design, and the data pipelines underneath. Track a fast-moving field and tell 2K what actually matters.
Must-Haves
A strong professional track record in product management, including direct experience taking AI or machine learning products from concept into production use by real customers.
Demonstrated ownership of a production AI system, with accountability for availability, cost, and output quality over time.
Practical fluency with modern AI application patterns, including retrieval, evaluation, fine-tuning, agentic workflows, and guardrails. You know the failure modes of each and when not to use them.
Experience owning platform or infrastructure products with broad internal customer bases and competing stakeholder priorities.
Comfort treating governance, risk, and compliance as product surfaces to design, not obstacles to route around.
Ability to distill technical tradeoffs into clear decisions for engineering teams and non-technical executives alike.
Comfort presenting to senior management and building organizational support for investments whose returns are measured in efficiency rather than direct revenue.
Nice-to-Haves
Experience in the gaming industry, with an understanding of AAA development workflows, live service operations, or publishing.
You actively build with AI tools yourself. Prototypes, evals, and working demos are part of how you communicate.
Hands-on experience with AI gateways, model routing layers, or LLM ops tooling. Experience managing inference spend, including cost attribution, usage governance, and unit economics for AI workloads.
Product experience in a regulated or audit-heavy environment where compliance requirements shaped the system architecture.

Coupang Fulfillment Services(이하 CFS)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터(Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 이커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.

CFS는 고객이 “쿠팡없이 어떻게 살았을까?”라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 할 유능한 인재를 기다립니다.

jobs.description: Amazon Shipping is building a high-growth business designed to transform how companies think about parcel delivery. As our Business Development organization scales, we are raising the bar on how our sellers show up with customers—from initial discovery and executive conversations through complex pricing discussions and negotiations. We are looking for an exceptional Sr. Sales Effectiveness Lead who is obsessed with improving how a large sales organization sells and can translate commercial strategy into measurable improvements in seller behavior and performance. In this role, you will own the development of the customer-facing capabilities that differentiate great Business Developers, including discovery, insight-led selling, Framemaking, value articulation, objection handling, pricing, and negotiation. You will embed Challenger principles into how BDs prepare for and lead customer conversations while building world-class negotiation capability that helps sellers frame value, anticipate buyer behavior, manage concessions, and hold price under pressure. You will partner closely with Sales, Pricing, and Finance to translate pricing strategy and commercial economics into practical negotiation strategies and support BDs preparing for complex, high-value customer negotiations. This is not a traditional training role. You will stay close to the field—observing customer interactions, listening to calls, inspecting deals and negotiations, analyzing performance data, and working directly with BDs and Sales leaders to diagnose where capability gaps are limiting performance. You will turn those insights into targeted interventions using coaching, deliberate practice, simulations, role-play, manager enablement, and formal learning, continuously measuring whether those mechanisms are changing how BDs sell. Your success will be measured by stronger seller capability, better customer conversations, increased negotiation effectiveness, greater pricing discipline, and improved commercial outcomes. Key job responsibilities • Own the sales effectiveness strategy for Amazon Shipping's Business Development organization, defining and continuously raising the standard for customer-facing selling. • Diagnose seller capability gaps using customer-call observation, deal and negotiation inspection, performance data, seller feedback, and direct partnership with Sales leaders. • Embed Challenger and Framemaking into how BDs discover customer needs, create differentiated perspectives, articulate value, handle objections, and advance opportunities. • Build and lead negotiation capability across the organization, including negotiation strategy, buyer psychology, value defense, anchoring, concession management, and give-get techniques. • Partner with Pricing and Finance to translate pricing strategy and commercial economics into practical guidance that helps BDs navigate pricing conversations and protect value. • Support complex and high-value customer negotiations by helping BDs prepare negotiation strategies, anticipate customer positions, identify leverage, plan concessions, and respond effectively under pressure. • Design and facilitate high-impact sales development through simulations, role-play, deal-based practice, coaching, certifications, and other mechanisms that replicate real customer situations. • Equip Sales leaders with practical coaching mechanisms and tools that reinforce effective selling behaviors in the field. • Measure effectiveness through observable changes in seller behavior, negotiation outcomes, pricing discipline, sales effectiveness, and commercial performance.

Lead integration and optimization of key IAM platforms including SailPoint, Okta, PingOne, Microsoft Entra ID, and other tools.
Drive Identity Lifecycle Management (LCM), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Just-In-Time access initiatives.

Serve as the primary IAM SME, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting complex issues, and mentoring other team members.

Participate in on-call rotation and incident response related to identity systems.

6+ years of hands-on experience in Identity and Access Management.
Thorough understanding of IAM principles and modern security concepts, including Zero Trust, Least Privilege, Adaptive/Risk-Based Authentication, Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC), Continuous Access Evaluation, and Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR).
Strong expertise in IAM protocols and standards: SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, and other federation protocols.

Strong working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS and GCP), Cloud IAM services, Terraform, and CI/CD practices.
Strong scripting and programming skills in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with extensive experience developing IAM workflows, automation, and integrations.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and drive projects from design through implementation.
This high-visibility role requires the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment.
